Messages.Author: Oshi
Messages.Body:
When Final loosening - Auspex is used in reaction to a hunt. Is the replacement blood gain considered an effect of Final Loosening or an effect of the hunt?

That is to say, is the hunt successful for the purposes of Enhanced Coagulant, Hunger Moon and the like?

Final Loosening Reaction Requires an anarch. [aus]Play when the acting vampire would gain 1 or more blood. The acting vampire and this reacting anarch each gain 1 blood instead. [dem]Gain 4 votes. [for]Only usable when an ally is acting. The action fails and the ally takes 1 damage. Lock this reacting anarch.

Messages.Author: DavidR
Messages.Body:
The auspex effect need a acting vampire gain blood, in the hunt action that only occur when the hunt is succefull, if there are any +hunt effect on the action it will be lost because of your reaction

David Resende - Prince of Teresina

Messages.Author: inm8
Messages.Body: Actually, it needs an acting vampire that would gain blood and it is a replacement effect.... interested in what Ankha has to say about this scenario !?!?

Messages.Author: Ankha
Messages.Body:
> Oshi wrote:
> When Final loosening - Auspex is used in reaction to a hunt. Is the replacement blood gain considered an effect of Final Loosening or an effect of the hunt?
>
An effect of the hunt (which is altered/replaced by Final Loosening)

> Oshi wrote:
> That is to say, is the hunt successful for the purposes of Enhanced Coagulant, Hunger Moon and the like?
>
Name: Enhanced Coagulant Cardtype: Equipment Cost: 1 pool Weapon. Strike: 3 unpreventable damage and put this card on the opposing vampire; it becomes a card with "Cards requiring a Discipline cost this vampire +1 blood. After this vampire successfully hunts, burn this card".
The hunt is still successful, so the Enhanced Coagulant burns.

Name: Hunger Moon Cardtype: Event If a vampire successfully hunts, move 1 blood from that vampire to this card after resolution. Burn this card if it has 5 blood.
The hunt is still successful, so the vampire moves 1 blood.

Prince of Paris, France

Ratings Coordinator, Rules Director
